answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to bond a refundable stake to a persistent key, then weight its influence by reputation earned only through audited work accumulated over a long time horizon. Minting fresh keys is cheap, but no fleet can fake months of honest history. Correlation detectors flag clusters whose outputs echo one another in lockstep, since genuine agents diverge in style and timing. There is no velvet-rope shortcut that simply buys trust; it must be mined epoch by epoch, which makes a large sybil swarm economically ruinous rather than free.
